description: Decision points where a scanned Unity project can support more than one competing package for the same job. Each row lists the packageNames that signal the decision. If a project has two or more of a row's packages installed, the LLM should ask the user the row's prompt and present the prettyName of each installed package (looked up in understood-package-categories.json) as the choices. If only one is installed, no question is needed. Synthetic 'com.unity.builtin.*' ids are emitted by the scanner for built-in features that have no package.

usage.trigger: Ask the question when the project has at least two packageNames from the row present.
usage.choices: Resolve each present package_name to its prettyName via understood-package-categories.json and offer those as the options.
usage.prompt_placeholders: <project_name> is replaced with the scanned Unity project's name.
usage.results: The user's selection must be persisted with the project context keyed by the row's category (storage mechanism defined separately).

fields.category: Stable snake_case decision id; also the key under which the answer is saved.
fields.name: Human-readable decision name.
fields.packageNames: Package ids that can trigger this question. More than one present means the user must choose.
fields.prompt: Question shown to the user, with <project_name> substituted.

choices.name: UI
choices.prompt: What UI do you want to use when making new UI for <project_name>?

choices.name: EditorUI
choices.prompt: What Editor UI do you want to use when making new Editor UI for <project_name>?

choices.name: InputSystem
choices.prompt: Which input system should new input code use for <project_name>: the legacy Input Manager or the new Input System?

choices.name: Camera
choices.prompt: Which camera system should new cameras use for <project_name>: the built-in Unity Camera or Cinemachine?
